newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan police arrest Briton on drug charge.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan police arrest Briton on drug charge.

text.p: Moroccan police on Sunday arrested a British man on charges of smuggling 77.5 kg (170.5 lbs) of hashish in the northern town of Al Hoceima, police sources said on Monday.
"The police have him in custody," one source said.
Briton Marc Cullinane, who had described himself as an artist, was travelling in his car towards the port of Tangier when police checked the vehicle and found the drugs, the sources added.

Cullinane, who comes from Bristol, was accompanied by his teenage daughter, the sources said. They did not name the girl nor say whether she was being held with him or handed over to the authorities for care outside the prison.
Two British women Sally Louise Griffiths and Claire Louise Martin were jailed last October for two and a half years for drug smuggling.
Another Briton David Richards was sentenced the same month to four years imprisonment for drug trafficking.
